inference_algorithm: Fit known-risk-factor regression; compute link-specific weights and an association score

name: Multiplicative relative-risk prediction model
model_likelihood: Rare-disease risk linked logarithmically to an approximately normal genetic score

estimand: ROC curve at a specified sibling relative recurrence risk
data_input: Population genetic-score distribution and sibling relative recurrence risk
